core_obligations: Choose finite affine open coverings of X and Y, get the induced affine covering of the product, and observe that it refines the pullbacks of both coverings, so there are maps of Cech complexes compatible with pullback on cohomology (proof lines 5980-5999).

Recall the map from the total tensor product of the two Cech complexes to the Cech complex of the tensor product sheaf, compatible with the cup product, and combine it with the refinement maps to build the comparison map displayed as equation (proof lines 6000-6018).

Identify the source and target of that map with the two sides of the statement: the Cech complexes compute the derived global sections by the affine vanishing and the Cech-to-derived comparison (proof lines 6018-6058).
Use the Kunneth formula on the Cech level to see that the map is the tensor product of the two comparison quasi-isomorphisms and hence an isomorphism (proof lines 6059-6140).

For the remaining identification, compute the higher direct images of the tensor product sheaf along the second projection: over an affine open of Y the Cech complex of the restricted covering equals the tensor product of the Cech complex on X with the sections of the other sheaf, and flatness makes the comparison a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 6140-6175).

Conclude that the sheafified Cech complex represents the higher direct images, so the direct image is the tensor product of the global sections of the first sheaf with the second sheaf, and finish with the Leray spectral sequence and the base change statement for the affine base, which shows that the higher cohomology of the product vanishes and that in degree zero the answer is the tensor product of the two global section modules (proof lines 6176-6192).
proof_roadmap: Set up a common affine refinement and the comparison map of Cech complexes (proof lines 5980-6018).
Identify source and target with the two sides of the statement via Cech-to-derived comparison (proof lines 6018-6058).
Apply the Cech level Kunneth formula to get an isomorphism (proof lines 6059-6140).
Compute the higher direct images of the tensor product and finish with Leray and base change (proof lines 6140-6192).
difficulty_reason: 213 行的大证明，是本章 Kunneth 一节的技术核心。四段都写实：①在共同的仿射加细上建立 Cech 复形之间的比较映射；②用仿射消没 + Cech-to-derived 比较把源与靶认成题面两侧；③在 Cech 层用 Kunneth 公式把映射拆成两个拟同构的张量积；④沿第二投影计算张量积层的高次顺像（在 Y 的仿射开集上 Cech 复形等于 X 侧 Cech 复形与截面的张量积，平坦性给出拟同构），再用 Leray 谱序列与对仿射基的基变换收尾。引用多达 13 处（4 同章、9 跨章），但都是把已知结果搬进来，承重演算（比较映射、识别、Cech-Kunneth、顺像计算）全在 span 内，故仍属完整证明、判 H3。**开篇有一句阅读建议（'We strongly urge the reader to read the proof of Varieties, Lemma ... first'），结尾一句明确说 'we omit the verification'（度数 0 处同构由杯积给出这一点未验证），两句均已按规则逐字记入 editorial_notes。**
